# All middlewares

Every middleware type Miabi curates. Each has a form in the console, validation on save, and encryption for any field holding a credential. See [Using middlewares](/docs/middlewares/overview) for how to attach them to a route and why the order matters.

## Access

| Middleware | Type | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| [Basic authentication](/docs/middlewares/basic-auth) | `basicAuth` | Require a username and password (HTTP Basic) to reach the route. |
| [JWT authentication](/docs/middlewares/jwt-auth) | `jwtAuth` | Require a valid JSON Web Token. Verify with a shared secret (HS*), a public key, or a JWKS endpoint. |
| [OpenID Connect (SSO)](/docs/middlewares/oidc) | `oidc` | Sign users in at the gateway against an identity provider, and pass who they are to the app. |
| [Forward authentication](/docs/middlewares/forward-auth) | `forwardAuth` | Delegate authentication to an external service, like Authelia or oauth2-proxy. |
| [LDAP authentication](/docs/middlewares/ldap-auth) | `ldapAuth` | Authenticate users against an LDAP / Active Directory directory. |

## Security

| Middleware | Type | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| [Block access](/docs/middlewares/access) | `access` | Deny requests to the matched paths with a fixed status code. |
| [IP access policy](/docs/middlewares/access-policy) | `accessPolicy` | Allow or deny requests by client IP / CIDR range. |
| [Request body limit](/docs/middlewares/body-limit) | `bodyLimit` | Reject requests whose body exceeds a size limit. |
| [Block user agents](/docs/middlewares/user-agent-block) | `userAgentBlock` | Reject requests whose User-Agent matches any of the listed patterns. |
| [Country access policy (GeoIP)](/docs/middlewares/geo-block) | `geoBlock` | Allow or deny requests by client country (GeoIP), with optional country-header enrichment for the backend. |

## Traffic

| Middleware | Type | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| [Rate limit](/docs/middlewares/rate-limit) | `rateLimit` | Throttle requests per client over a time unit. |
| [HTTP cache](/docs/middlewares/http-cache) | `httpCache` | Cache responses at the gateway so repeat requests never reach the app. |

## Transform

| Middleware | Type | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| [Force scheme (HTTPS)](/docs/middlewares/redirect-scheme) | `redirectScheme` | Redirect requests to a different scheme — typically http→https. |
| [Redirect](/docs/middlewares/redirect) | `redirect` | Redirect every matched request to a fixed URL. |
| [Redirect (regex)](/docs/middlewares/redirect-regex) | `redirectRegex` | Redirect using a regular-expression match on the request path. |
| [Rewrite path (regex)](/docs/middlewares/rewrite-regex) | `rewriteRegex` | Rewrite the request path with a regular expression before it reaches the app. |
| [Add path prefix](/docs/middlewares/add-prefix) | `addPrefix` | Prepend a path prefix before forwarding the request to the app. |
| [Request headers](/docs/middlewares/request-headers) | `requestHeaders` | Add, override or remove headers before the request reaches the app. |
| [Response headers](/docs/middlewares/response-headers) | `responseHeaders` | Add, override or remove headers on the response, and set CORS or cookies. |

## Observability

| Middleware | Type | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| [Error interceptor](/docs/middlewares/error-interceptor) | `errorInterceptor` | Replace upstream error responses with a custom body or template. |

:::note Uncatalogued types
A middleware type Miabi does not curate can still be used: the rule is passed to the gateway as written. It gets no form, no validation and no encryption of its fields, so a credential in one is stored in the clear. Prefer a curated type where one exists.
:::
